segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Create an anchor entity. let myAnchor = AnchorEntity() // Create the scene root. let sceneRootEntity = Entity() sceneRootEntity.name = "Scene Root" myAnchor.addChild(sceneRootEntity) // Create the physics origin. let physicsRootEntity = Entity() physicsOriginEntity.name = "Physics Origin" myAnchor.addChild(physicsOriginEntity) // Add the anchor and specify the physics origin. arView.scene.addAnchor(myAnchor); self.arView.physicsOrigin = physicsOriginEntity ```
